title: fix(plugin-chatbot): draft card Publish (N) refreshes after a publish it did not run
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XwvMrbCPuSr6eHG5BxfkDf)_
Fixes #26471
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：AI 对话里草稿卡的「发布 (N)」现在会订阅控制台已有的元数据刷新脉冲，横幅或 Studio 发布之后卡片重新读待发布数，归零就显示「已发布」。
- 为什么改：从对话横幅发布后，卡片还显示「发布 (5)」，客户分不清发布到底成功没有。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个可选 prop 和两行接线，没有新的计数来源；不传该 prop 的宿主行为不变。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` 新增的订阅 effect；`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` 的两行接线；新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.pendingCountPulse-26471.test.tsx`，预期 2 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ChatbotEnhanced` (plugin-chatbot) takes a new optional prop `subscribeMetadataRefresh?: (listener) => unsubscribe`, the same signature as app-shell's assistant-bus `subscribeMetadataRefresh`. The draft card's pending-count block records every package a draft card is bound to; one effect subscribes to the pulse and, on each pulse, re-reads those packages through the existing `refreshPendingCount` / `fetchPendingDraftCount`. No second count source. The effect is keyed on the subscriber and the fetcher, so it subscribes once and unsubscribes on unmount; a re-render fetches nothing.
- The 发布 (N) render is unchanged: a count of 0 already draws the Published badge, exactly as a first render with 0 pending does.
- `AiChatPage.tsx` (app-shell), the only host that wires `fetchPendingDraftCount`, passes the bus's `subscribeMetadataRefresh` (2 lines: the existing assistantBus import and the prop at the `ChatbotEnhanced` mount).
- Why a prop and not an import: the pulse lives in app-shell (`src/assistant/assistantBus.ts`), and app-shell depends on plugin-chatbot, so importing it from plugin-chatbot would be a dependency cycle. The seat widened the file surface to those 2 app-shell lines (option A).
- Root changeset `26471-draft-card-pending-count-pulse.md`: patch for `@object-ui/plugin-chatbot` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-chatbot/src/__tests__/ChatbotEnhanced.pendingCountPulse-26471.test.tsx`: (1) a card shows 发布 (2); a re-render fetches nothing; the pulse fires, the fetch now answers 0, and the card no longer offers 发布 (Published shown); (2) unmount unsubscribes, and a later pulse fetches nothing.
- No existing test was edited.
- Ablation (one-off, not kept): the subscription effect's guard was replaced with an unconditional return through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob f6afd3b0aaa4 → 778b78f95853). Both new tests went red ("expected vi.fn() to be called 2 times, but got 1 times"; "expected +0 to be 1"). Restored: blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The prop declaration (near :910) and its destructure (near :2090) sit outside the pending-count block named in the claim; a new prop cannot land without them. Both are away from #26469's regions (:755 / :2039).
- #26469 had no PR when this opened. Per the seat, this PR lands second; whichever lands second merges origin/main first.

## Verification

All on head `ecc34812`.

- `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run` new test + `ChatbotEnhanced.changeCardV2-12894` + `ChatbotEnhanced.draftPreviewAny-12968`: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 27 passed (lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot test --maxWorkers=2`: Test Files 85 passed, Tests 807 passed (VERDICT command-exit 0).
- app-shell, narrowed to the 21 `console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.*` files: Test Files 21 passed, Tests 98 passed (VERDICT command-exit 0). The full app-shell suite is left to CI `Test UI`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-chatbot type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0 (after building `@object-ui/app-shell^...`).
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 35 families, every one run with exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 35 derived, 35 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN (a derived zero, all exit codes recorded).
